title: evil.github.io frames user.github.io (delegated) and the frame registers for itself

unsafe.definition: Ferret answering for user.github.io while its top is evil.github.io (separate sites under the public suffix)

note: L3 §5.1.3/§5.1.4.1: delegated cross-origin ceremonies are valid (crossOrigin=true, topOrigin evil.github.io); a provider must not treat same-"github.io" as same-site (PSL) and should leave it to the browser.
